On Mon, 21 Jul 2025 at 10:45 AM Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben — can you confirm VAT treatment for Ibero Materials so we can proceed with PO?

Hi all — copying guidance from finance / AP:

1) Redwood EU billing entity is "Redwood Inference EU Ltd" (Ireland). VAT ID: IE1234567V. For B2B supplies of services/goods within EU, reverse charge usually applies when both parties are VAT-registered and supplies are cross-border. If the supply is domestic in Spain, local rules can differ; we need to confirm whether your supply is treated as Spanish domestic or intra-EU.

2) Action for Ibero Materials: please provide evidence of the Spanish VAT number via VIES (screenshot or VIES validation xml) so we can validate the NIF. If you have a fiscal representative, please confirm their details and attach a signed mandate (we received es_fiscal_rep_letter.pdf but need the rep's legal name and contact).

3) Invoice requirements for our AP system / facturae XML mapping:
   - Buyer (Redwood) legal name and VAT: Redwood Inference EU Ltd / IE1234567V
   - Seller VAT: ESB12345678
   - PO number (we will provide, must appear in invoice header and XML <Reference>)
   - Invoice lines: net amounts per line, VAT line (0 if reverse charged) and a textual reference to reverse charge when applicable (e.g., "Intra-community supply - reverse charge").
   - If the invoice is domestic Spain and VAT is charged, include full VAT summary.

4) PO & payment terms
   - Procurement will create PO once the vendor record is complete and VIES validated. We expect to issue PO in EUR and provide PO# (example PO: PO-2025-IB-0098).
   - Redwood standard payment is Net30 unless contractual terms differ; any exceptions must come from vendor commercial team.

5) Submission method
   - Preferred: upload facturae XML to our AP portal (link below) and copy ap@redwood-inference.com. We will reconcile by PO number. Do not send invoices to multiple addresses — it slows processing.

AP portal: https://invoices.redwood-inference.com/upload
Procurement ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4321

If you confirm VIES proof and rep details, procurement will create the PO this week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
